variables.name: LEAST_IMPORTANT_FIRST
variables.comment:
* Sorts cue infos in order of ascending {@link Cea708CueInfo#priority} (which is descending by
     * numeric value).

variables.name: priority
variables.comment:
* The priority of the cue box. Low values are higher priority. * *

If cue boxes overlap, higher priority cue boxes are drawn on top. * *

See 8.4.2 of the CEA-708B spec.
